verdict.rationale: BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is explicitly documented as a data exchange platform for discovering, sharing and accessing third-party/Google curated datasets and combining them with internal data, directly inside the platform. Multiple docs confirm this cross-org discovery and combination workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence/user reports specifically validating the marketplace discovery/enrichment workflow (community evidence only covers other BigQuery aspects like pricing/performance, not the marketplace).
